correctness.rationale: The generator is irreducible at every positive epsilon; stationary flux gives pi=(1,epsilon,1,epsilon,epsilon)/(2+3epsilon). Independent exponential tours yield the exact zero-frequency variance, and the five-equation resolvent yields the intermediate-frequency limit. A polynomial sum-of-squares identity establishes A/B<=12/5 with the exact equality ray. The witness lower bounds, rather than asserts equality for, the five-state global efficiency. Finite rational resolver checks reproduce the formulas; the limiting conclusion follows from analytic estimates.
